MyWhisper — local voice dictation for macOS (Apple Silicon)
=============================================================

Dictate in ~100 languages with a hotkey. 100% offline: your voice
never leaves your Mac. Free.

INSTALL (one time, ~2 minutes)
------------------------------

1. Drag MyWhisper.app into your Applications folder.

2. Double-click "Download Model.command" to fetch the speech model
   (~1.5 GB, one time). If macOS blocks it: right-click the file →
   Open → Open.

3. Open MyWhisper.app. macOS will block it the first time because
   this free build isn't notarized by Apple:
   → System Settings → Privacy & Security → scroll down →
     "MyWhisper.app was blocked…" → click "Open Anyway".

4. Grant the two permissions it asks for:
   - Microphone (to hear you)
   - Accessibility (to paste text into other apps)

USE
---

- Tap Option+Space, speak, tap again → text appears where your
  cursor is. Hold Option+Space to talk-while-holding instead.
- The waveform icon in the menu bar has everything else:
  languages (including Mixed Indonesian+English), models, AI modes,
  history, and Settings (Cmd+,).

PRIVACY
-------

No accounts, no telemetry, no cloud. The only network connections
the app makes are to itself (localhost). The one-time model
download (step 2) fetches from Hugging Face; after that, everything
is fully offline.
